name: OpenCode Theme
description: Pixel-perfect port of the official OpenCode palette (anomalyco/opencode): #9d7cd8 violet headings, #7fd88f mint code, #f5a742 amber highlights, and monospace typography.

zh-CN.name: OpenCode 极客高清主题
zh-CN.description: 1:1 严格对齐 OpenCode 官方源码（anomalyco/opencode）配色定义：#9d7cd8 优雅紫罗兰标题、#7fd88f 清新薄荷绿行内代码、#f5a742 暖金重点，带来极致清晰排版。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 纯样式插件。仅贡献全局主题（只有 CSS 样式定义）。无网络请求、文件读写、剪贴板或智能体工具访问。

en.name: OpenCode Theme
en.description: Pixel-perfect port of the official OpenCode palette (anomalyco/opencode): #9d7cd8 violet headings, #7fd88f mint code, #f5a742 amber highlights, and monospace typography.
en.safetyNotes: Pure styling. The plugin contributes global themes (CSS only). No network, file, clipboard, or agent access.

author: hzz12138
changelog: Release 1.2.0: 像素级全面对齐 OpenCode 官方源码规范——全屏对话正文与代码统一为 JetBrains Mono / Cascadia Code 现代等宽排版；去除行内代码多余胶囊背景与实线边框，还原纯净薄荷绿（#7fd88f）语法穿透感；去除标题多余下划线，呈现纯粹紫罗兰（#9d7cd8）；背景全面下潜至极客纯黑（#0a0a0a）。
safetyNotes: Pure styling. The plugin contributes global themes (CSS only). No network, file, clipboard, or agent access.
